newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four killed in Russian army shooting -- Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Russian army shooting -- Interfax.

text.p: Two Russian soldiers killed four of their comrades on Thursday and escaped to the woods and hills of the remote Sakhalin Island with a large haul of arms and ammunition, Interfax news agency said.

Interfax quoted "competent sources" as saying that two recent recruits were patrolling a local military airport when they suddenly opened fire with Kalashnikov assault rifles, killing an officer and three other members of the patrol.
Two other soldiers managed to flee to safety, Interfax said.
Officials were not immediately available for comment.

Interfax, which gave no reason for the shootings, said army and police units were looking for the two attackers. They had seized three Kalashnikovs, a pistol and a large amount of ammunition on Sakhalin, off Russia's Pacific coast.
Several similar incidents have been reported in the region in recent months, most of them caused by poor discipline and low morale in cash-strapped garrisons.
Defence Minister Igor Rodionov arrived in the Far East port of Vladivostok on Thursday for an inspection tour aimed at improving the situation with the armed forces in this remote part of Russia.
